cohort: Women of childbearing age (<45 years) with acute aortic dissection (AAD)
finding: While the frequency of AAD in young women was low, pregnancy, particularly the immediate postpartum period, may increase the risk of AAD in those genetically predisposed.
mod_finding: Four out of five women who developed AAD in the immediate postpartum period (<3 months) had delivered via cesarean section.
gest_age: Second and third trimester (for the 3 patients who presented with AAD during pregnancy)
